gui.guhs.herinnering.bel: A memory bubble... there's a little film inside.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_gezien: You know this film already. Click the bubble to watch it again.
gui.guhs.herinnering.bel_dicht: This bubble is still shut. Watch the other two memories first.
gui.guhs.herinnering.persoon_snoes: A little Snoes, from long ago. He doesn't see you. He's inside his memory.
gui.guhs.herinnering.stukje: Piece found: the memory. Snoes thought he was always alone... but he never quite was.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k1: Long ago. Snoes was only a very little guh.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k2: In the grass lay something yellow. It smelled of cheese.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k3: Is that... for me? There's no name on it.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k4: He waited. Maybe someone would come for it. Nobody came.
scene.guhs.herinnering_knabbel.k6: His very first cheese nibble. Nobody saw. But he never forgot it.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.titel: Memory: the first night with a Blub
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b1: A cold night. The wind whistled through the grass.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b2: Brrr. Everyone has a place. I only have wind.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b3: Then something soft came hopping along. It squeaked, very softly.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b5: The Blub snuggled up to him, out of the wind. It said nothing. It just stayed.
scene.guhs.herinnering_blub.b6: For the first time, Snoes slept. Only a little bit. When he woke up, the Blub was gone.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s1: A clear night. Snoes lay in the grass, counting stars.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s2: One, two... a hundred... one more... and one more...
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s3: Then he saw it: a few stars together. Two little ears. A little snout.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s4: A guh! There's a guh living up there too. All alone... just like me.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s5: He waved. The stars twinkled back.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s6: Then together we're a little less alone. Good night, star guh. Njeg.
scene.guhs.herinnering_sterren.s7: Snoes had a place nowhere. But from that night on he knew: there's always someone who twinkles back.
